title: Orientals in Cuban music; Mario Bauza's teacher
summary: No Chinese-Cubans took up music except Mario Bauza's teacher, whose father was Chinese.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Okay, Macho, did any Orientals get into music in Cuba?

Ahh, this fellow, this particular fellow, Mario Bauza's teacher, he was young, his father was Chinese and his mother was black and he became a musician. I don't know how, maybe the mother because a Cuban mother is a very ah - enthusiastic about the progress of the child, like a Puerto Rican mother, Colombian or whatever, we have certain desire to make progress in the house.
